critical_errors.issue: V_pi,R is defined as a local system, whose pullback has locally constant sections. The gauged logarithms need not be locally constant: already for a trivial annulus bundle with d=0, log|T| varies along each fiber's skeleton. Adding a function pulled back from the base cannot remove this variation. The linear transition law constructs a continuous section of the associated real vector bundle, but does not establish the asserted section of the pullback local system.

Interpret the pairing in that bundle and retain a as a parallel dual section. With this corrected target, the gluing argument applies.
